about_the_game:
This DLC contains:

The Art and Lore of City of Springs

An high quality artbook with 135 pages filled with high quality renders, artwork, concept art, background information on the loor and behind the scenes information on the development of the game.

The Artbook is written in our best grasp of the English language. French, German, Dutch or Spanish versions are not included.

The Music of City of Springs
You get to download the music of the game in MP3 or high quality Flac files. Listen to it while studying, at work, in the bus, at home, during your tabletop rpg sessions or just anywhere. The soundtrack of the game was carefully crafted by Fons Beijer, who worked with various artists for playing the string instruments and doing the vocals that can be heard on the track. We're very proud to have their music in our game, and gladly share it with you to truly enjoy.
